messages.text: Unfortunately, no. A request rejected by staff does not keep the refund window open, even if it was submitted on time. Your cushion’s deadline was November 8, 2026, at 10:00 UTC, and the shop has confirmed that a new request is now outside that window. I can’t request another refund for it. (refund-policy/v2/window)
